does_not_cover: No hypergeometric, geometric, or Poisson case appears, so distribution choice is never actually exercised.
The normal approximation and continuity correction are absent; every probability is enumerated or plugged in by hand.
Samples larger than seven never occur, so sampling variability of real survey sizes stays invisible.
notes: Heavy repetition from the doubled captions slows the pace; the Fanta survey keeps it concrete. The two-sided p-value computation is testing machinery: teaches knowledge-sad-l10-tails-pvalue — reassignment signal.
